blocks.text: REINA MERCEDES, Isabela — Reina Mercedes, Isabela Vice Mayor Jeryll Harold Respicio on Wednesday (October 7) has been cleared by a P28,000 drug test at the St. Luke Medical Center in Quezon City. After he got the results on Wednesday (October 7), the local official joked that Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla should now reimburse him. “Jonvic, refund me. The drug test is pricey,” Respicio said after posting the results of the test for cocaine, ecstasy, opiates, methamphetamine, tricyclic antidepressants, terrahydrocannabinol, poproxyphen and benzodiazepenes.
